subject: Can I install Deducer without Java 6?

messages.author: aa883f8c9bf9704d
messages.subject: Can I install Deducer without Java 6?
parts:
Hello!

I can't use Deducer on a Mac because when I use the "library(JGR)" command I get an error message saying that I need to install the "legacy Java SE 6 runtime". Is there any way around this? I don't want to install Java 6 since it may screw other software I have installed.

Thanks for your help.

Sincerely,

Gerardo

messages.author: 267c7c6c510dc8a2
messages.subject: Re: Can I install Deducer without Java 6?
parts:
You do need to have Java installed and you can either use the old Java 6 shipped by Apple, or the latest from Oracle. Do you have Java installed? If so, what version?

If you have Java installed and it is not being recognized by R, you can try installing rJava from source

install.packages(“rJava”,type=“source”)

Best,
Ian
